# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest release on the `5.x` branch.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 0.1   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, please email [info@syriable.com](mailto:info@syriable.com) instead of using the public issue tracker.

Include as much detail as possible: affected versions, reproduction steps, and the potential impact. We aim to acknowledge reports within a few business days.

Please do not disclose security issues publicly until a fix is available.
